text: Dynamics is a core branch of physics and engineering, mainly studying the relationship between the changes in the motion state of objects (or systems) and the forces they are subjected to, as well as the transmission laws of physical quantities such as energy and momentum. It encompasses not only the dynamics of particles and rigid bodies in classical mechanics, but also extends to interdisciplinary fields such as fluid dynamics, quantum dynamics, and engineering dynamics. It is a fundamental discipline for addressing issues such as motion analysis, system control, and energy conversion.
